release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.30 (Build 30) - Media Caching & PDF Viewing Enhancements:
- Comprehensive media caching system - persistent cache for images, videos, and documents across all platforms
- Faster chat screen performance - media loads instantly from cache after first view
- Persistent cache across app restarts - cached media remains available even after closing the app
- Automatic media preloading - background preloading of media when chat screen loads
- Enhanced PDF full-screen viewing - fixed PDF viewing for single and multiple documents
- Improved PDF detection - enhanced detection logic for better PDF identification
- Better loading states - proper loading indicators and timeout handling for PDFs
- Media cache management - automatic cleanup of old files and size limit enforcement (500MB max)
- Web platform support - browser HTTP cache integration for web platform
- Android/iOS cache support - file-based persistent cache for mobile platforms
- PDF viewing fixes - resolved black screen issues when opening PDFs in full screen
- Multiple PDF support - fixed full-screen viewing for multiple PDFs sent together
- Cache statistics - track cache size and file count for monitoring
- Performance optimizations - reduced network usage and faster media loading
